items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I mean as much as John Coltrane loved Dexter Gordon and Sonny Rollins and he would tell you he loved everybody because he was influenced by all these people.

ctx.x: Because you know what happens is a person is not really searching for their sound. I mean as much as John Coltrane loved Dexter Gordon and Sonny Rollins and he would tell you he loved everybody because he was influenced by all these people. I mean I’ll never forget somebody was interviewing him and he was saying well who’s your influences and he said, “Well I love Dexter and I love Sonny Rollins,” and he said, “really everybody.” I mean there was nobody that did not influence him. And I remember my father telling…
You think that we’re turning out thousands of jazz degree-holding musicians every year now. What are they going to do?
